description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa in the upper-right living area facing inward toward the seating cluster; dining table to the left of the sofa with 4 chairs. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is living area, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); people needing significant storage (no wardrobe noted); remote workers requiring a dedicated home office (no desk space); those wanting a private master suite (bedroom accessed through living).
